about:
server/pi-tree.test.ts: pi's entry tree moves the conversation when a /tree branch is appended, and invalidates the page (its last assertion, a cursor held from the branch navigated away from cannot page the new one, with a cursor that is not null: the original's session fits one page, so the cursor it passes is null)
server/pi.test.ts: pi transcripts render as chat starts a fresh history when /new or /resume moves the pane to another file (the same assertion, for a move within one file)
